assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: potential incident during routine operation on PSV-4111

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-4111 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. PSV-4111 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during routine operation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 23 April 2019 a potential incident was recorded on PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
